description: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed. abilities.name: Soul Assumption
description: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than 100 damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge. Base damage: 20. Damage per charge: 70. Max charges: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6. Charge duration: 6. Damage required for a charge: 100. Charge collection radius: 1800. Cooldown: 4. Cast range: 1000. Mana cost: 110.

abilities.name: Gravekeeper's Cloak
description: Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage. If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover. Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within 900 range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has. Max layers: 4. Damage reduction per layer: 8% / 12% / 16% / 20%. Layer recovery time: 7 / 6 / 5 / 4. Minimum damage: 40. Maximum damage reduction: 32% / 48% / 64% / 80%.

abilities.name: Summon Familiars
description: Conjures 2 blind Familiars to fight for Visage. Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing. While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health. Familiars grant high bounty when killed. The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after 4s, during which they cannot attack or act. Familiar health: 450 / 600 / 750. Familiar armor: 2 / 3 / 4. Familiar attack range: 180. Familiar movement speed: 430. Familiar bounty: 100. Familiar damage: 25 / 50 / 75. Cooldown: 120 / 110 / 100. Mana cost: 150.
